==Biography==
Leandro Marcos is from La Rioja, Argentina.

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''Newbie''' comes from the game ''ImperiumAO'', where the players under level 14 are called "newbies".
* He has many tattoos.
* He has a cat named Ramón.
* First Latin American player who reached Challenger in KR server.
* Second Latin American player to be imported to a major region, after [[Josedeodo]].

=== Individual Awards ===
* LLA player with the most MVPs during the year (2020)
* LLA All Pro Team x2 (Opening 2020, Closing 2020)
* LLA Most Valuable Player of the split x2 (Opening 2020, Closing 2020)
* LLA player with the most MVPs in the split (Opening 2020)
* LLA Most Weekly MVPs in his role in the split (Opening 2020)
